records.subject: ATaO3 perovskite oxides (A = Rb, Fr)
records.quote: In the present manuscript, structural, optoelectronic and mechanical properties of perovskite oxides ATaO(3) (A = alkali metals = Rb, Fr) have been investigated using first principles study based on density functional theory (DFT).
context_quotes: These calculations involve full potential linearly augmented plane wave (FP-LAPW) technique along with Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof-generalized gradient approximation (PBE-GGA) and PBEso1 exchange potentials within the framework of WIEN2K code.
In addition, PBE plus Tran and Blaha modified Becke-Johnson (PBE + TB-mBJ) functional have been utilized to improve the electronic properties.
These compounds belong to the semiconductor category, which include contributions of Rb-d, Fr-d/f, Ta-d and O-2p orbitals to explore their behavior.
